title: Neon Hoop Rush
tagline: Flick a glowing ball through neon hoops, chain combos, beat the clock.
description: Neon Hoop Rush is a 3D arcade flick-shot game built for short, addictive sessions in your browser. Drag your finger upward to aim, watch the dotted ghost trajectory plot the perfect arc, and release to flick a glowing ball through floating neon hoops in a synthwave city. Every clean pass adds time to the clock and stacks your combo multiplier higher — chain three hits for ×1.5, five for ×2, ten for ×3, and watch the music climb a pentatonic scale with each consecutive score. Hoops drift, rotate, and respawn at varying distances, and the further the hoop the bigger the bonus. Miss and your combo resets — but you keep your score and your bestseller of the run. One round lasts thirty seconds plus whatever time you earn back, perfect for a coffee break or a commute. Play instantly, no install, install as a PWA on your home screen, share your high score, and get ready to chase that next perfect swish. Optimized for portrait mobile browsers with one-thumb controls and a clean, neon visual style — no waste, no ads in the way of the action, just pure score-chase fun.

controls.en: Drag upward to aim, release to flick. Combo for higher score and bonus time.
controls.ja: 上にドラッグして狙い、離してフリック。コンボでスコアと延長時間が伸びる。
